content.thinking: The alert fired at 09:26:50, but logs show the ramp actually starting at 09:21 with full rollout by 09:22, lining up with when the p99 jump began—so this confirms a feature-flag toggle from off to on. Error rate stayed flat while p99 latency climbed from 1338 to 1711, which fits the flag switching on some more expensive code path.

hypotheses.subject: monthly-spend-feature
hypotheses.summary: The feature flag `monthly-spend-feature` was switched from off to on, ramping at 09:21 and fully on at 09:22, which is exactly the minute p99 latency jumped from ~200ms to 1338ms and stayed elevated. No code or config deployment occurred in the preceding 24 hours, and request volume, error rate and memory were flat.
